## Summary

One or two sentences describing the change.

## Related issue

Fixes #<issue-number>.

## Type of change

- [ ] Typo / wording fix
- [ ] Link correction
- [ ] New section or asset
- [ ] CI / workflow change
- [ ] Brand / asset change
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I have previewed the rendered Markdown locally.
- [ ] I have not introduced any new "ambitious / world-changing / weird" filler.
- [ ] I have not changed `LICENSE`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, or `SECURITY.md`.
- [ ] For visual changes, I have attached a before / after screenshot.
- [ ] For new sections, I have explained why the change is needed in the PR
      description.
